title: ε-PrivateSMOTE
summary: A research codebase for the ε-PrivateSMOTE proposal, evaluating privacy-preserving data transformation techniques (differential privacy, deep learning synthesizers, and PrivateSMOTE) against predictive performance and linkability risk on tabular datasets. It runs SDV's CTGAN, TVAE, and CopulaGAN synthesizers to generate deep-learning-based synthetic data variants and uses sdmetrics for data utility measures.
evidence: code/transformations/deep_learning.py:69-73 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table
